strategies.name: Mean reversion
strategies.instruments: ~500 liquid US large caps (NSDQ250 universe), SPY regime
strategies.summary: Cross-sectional pullback portfolio: buy the most oversold names (RSI-2) inside their own 200-day uptrend, ≤10 names at once, exit on the first strength. bb / nr7 single-symbol modes remain in the script for reference.
strategies.rule_sketch: Signal at close t: close > SMA200, RSI(2) < entry, no earnings inside the hold window. Rank by RSI; resting limit at close - k×ATR(14) for the next session (passive fill, no spread crossing), ≤10 names, equal notional. Exit at the close when RSI(2) > 70 or close > SMA5, or after max_hold sessions.

strategies.name: Dealer gamma (GEX)
strategies.summary: Dealer gamma positioning sets the intraday regime: long-gamma pins and mean-reverts; short-gamma trends. Reads positioning, not price.
strategies.rule_sketch: Build GEX from the SPX chain (OI × gamma). Trade MES/ES gap-fade or wall-revert when gex_z and walls agree. Signal from the prior close / overnight snapshot.

strategies.name: Vol carry put spreads
strategies.summary: Harvest the variance risk premium by selling put spreads only in VIX/VIX3M contango. Mirror image of the VWAP book, which buys premium.
strategies.rule_sketch: Gate on VIX/VIX3M < 0.95 and VIX not at the cheap extreme. Sell ~15-delta put, buy 1% lower. Exit at 50% max profit, 2× credit stop, or 21 DTE.

strategies.name: Calendar effects
strategies.holding_period: A few sessions around the event
strategies.summary: Turn-of-month drift, FOMC announcement drift, and opex-week patterns on the index future.
strategies.rule_sketch: Long around month-end / FOMC / opex windows from fomc_dates.csv. Fill next open; flat after the window. Costs always on.

strategies.name: MNQ CVD / VWAP
strategies.summary: Absorption: price makes a new session extreme but CVD does not. Fade back to VWAP. Microstructure, not Renko/MCO.
strategies.rule_sketch: Session CVD + VWAP σ-bands on 1-minute MNQ. Enter on divergence at the band; target VWAP; time stop 60 bars.

strategies.name: Sector rotation
strategies.summary: Cross-sectional momentum: long the leading sectors, cash when the 200-day filter fails. Different from time-series NQ momentum.
strategies.rule_sketch: Rank XLK…XLC on blended 3/6/12-month return (skip last week). Hold top N above their SMA200, else that slot is cash. Equal or inverse-vol weights, optional book vol target, monthly or semi-monthly rebalance at the next open, 5 bps turnover cost.

strategies.name: Breadth regime
strategies.instruments: Regime switch from ~500-name breadth; P&L shown on SPY
strategies.summary: Participation breadth of ~500 names vs SPY. Switches the other sleeves on or off (01 pullback reads its regime file). Not a standalone P&L engine.
strategies.rule_sketch: % of constituents above their 50-day SMA (or a breadth thrust). Risk-on when breadth is above the threshold and SPY is above SMA200; risk-off otherwise. Writes results/07_breadth_regime_regime.csv.

strategies.name: PEAD / implied move
strategies.instruments: ~500 US large caps (NSDQ250 universe) with Yahoo earnings dates
strategies.summary: Post-earnings drift when the reaction exceeds the options-implied move. Uses the options market as an input, not the instrument.
strategies.rule_sketch: After earnings, if |reaction| exceeds move_mult × the name's own expected move (mean |reaction| of its last 8 prints), hold in the surprise direction for N sessions with an ATR stop; ≤ max_positions names, biggest surprise first. Long by default; optional short on misses.
